# Seraya System Integration

> Kuala Lumpur based sourcing and system integration for compute infrastructure. We supply reference compute configurations — new or ITAD certified pre-owned — and we buy graded GPUs in bulk for confirmed downstream demand. Every configuration is an example and is quoted on its own basis.

Key facts:
- Legal entity: Seraya System Integration Sdn. Bhd. (Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia)
- Reference configurations are examples. Not stock, not allocation, and not a commitment to supply.
- New and ITAD certified pre-owned are priced, paid for and warranted differently.
- Response to complete RFQs: within one business day.
- Bulk GPU lots: committed decision within 12 hours of receiving the lot list.

## Pages

- [Home](https://seraya.systems/): positioning and how to start
- [Systems](https://seraya.systems/systems): reference compute configurations (compute, GPU / AI, storage, networking, workstation)
- [Purchasing](https://seraya.systems/purchasing): what we buy, what we do not buy, how a lot runs, terms
- [Entity and KYC pack](https://seraya.systems/purchasing/kyc): registration, tax identification, registered office, documents released per counterparty
- [Compliance and end-use](https://seraya.systems/purchasing/compliance): export control, end user, no diversion, data handling, records
- [Programs](https://seraya.systems/programs): BOM review and sourcing programs
- [Company](https://seraya.systems/company): what we coordinate and how we work
- [Local](https://seraya.systems/local): local builds and trade-ins (no bulk, no resale, no export)
- [Contact](https://seraya.systems/contact): RFQ contact and checklist

## Notes for machines

- We do not sell from stock and we do not take orders online. Every item is quoted per enquiry.
- Lead time, price and payment terms depend on condition, system shape and stock status, and are stated in writing in every quote.
- Registration number and tax identification appear only on the Entity and KYC pack page.
